4
Are you debt recycling?
Converting home loan debt into deductible investment debt. Skip this if it does not apply to you.
Debt Recycling
A record of what you have recycled, and the deduction it implies. It tracks, it does not advise.
Read this before relying on any of it. This records amounts you tell it you have recycled and works out the interest and tax effect arithmetically. It does not check that your arrangement actually qualifies. Deductibility depends on the use to which the borrowed funds are put, and mixing deductible and non-deductible borrowings in one loan account can contaminate the deduction entirely. Most arrangements need properly split loan facilities and careful record keeping. Get advice from a registered tax agent before recycling and before claiming anything.

One row per sale in the selected year. This is what the summary above is built from, so it is also your working if anyone asks.

Folder Sync (optional)
Pick a file once and Folionaire writes straight to it. Choose somewhere inside your Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud or Google Drive folder and their sync carries it to your other devices. There is no account and no server here: the file goes from this browser to your disk, and your own cloud app takes it from there.
Heads up: you have opened this file straight from disk. Browsers often block writing to a chosen file in that situation. If it does not work, either use the hosted copy or simply set your browser’s download folder to your synced folder and keep using Save.
Auto-sync:
Market Widgets (off by default)
Adds an economic calendar, index overview, crypto heatmap and technical ratings to the Terminal page, provided by TradingView. Turning this on loads a script from TradingView, so they will see your IP address and any symbol you look up. Your holdings are never sent: the widgets only ever show generic market data or a symbol you type yourself. Leave it off and nothing loads.
Tips & Hints
Short hints appear on each page explaining what it does and what you have not tried yet. Each one shows once, then the set cycles again.
Exchange Rate (AUD/USD)
Used for Combined views, Wealth Plan and the Currency Exposure risk check.
Franking Credit Rate
Most companies pay tax at 30%. Base rate entities (turnover under $50m) use 25%. This sets the default for new dividend entries, and each entry can override it individually if you hold a mix of both.
Custom Price Proxy (optional)
If price fetching is slow or blocked - most common when opening the file directly on a phone - you can route requests through your own free Cloudflare Worker. It becomes the first-choice route, with the built-in free proxies as fallback. Copy the Worker code below, deploy it on Cloudflare (steps included, free tier is plenty), then paste its URL here.
How to deploy (free, ~5 minutes)
  1. Click Copy Worker code below.
  2. Sign up / log in at dash.cloudflare.com (free, no card).
  3. In the left menu go to Build > Compute (Workers & Pages).
  4. Click Create application > Start with Hello World > name it (e.g. folionaire-price-updates) > Deploy.
  5. Click Edit code, delete the sample, paste the copied code, then Deploy.
  6. Copy the Worker URL (https://name.account.workers.dev), paste it above, hit Test, then Save.
The code only allows Folionaire's data sources, so nobody can misuse your Worker as an open proxy. The free tier (100k requests/day) is far more than one person needs.

About
Folionaire v1.1 - Personal portfolio tracker

Not financial or tax advice
Folionaire is a personal tracking and information tool only - it is not financial, investment, or tax advice. The CGT and tax figures are estimates based on general Australian rules and may not reflect your circumstances. Before you rely on any of these figures, have a registered tax agent review one full financial year of output against your own records. What is applied: your chosen parcel method (FIFO, LIFO, minimise gain, maximise gain or minimise tax), the 12-month discount test with the acquisition day excluded, brokerage in the cost base, capital losses offset before the 50% discount, prior-year losses, AMIT cost base adjustments, returns of capital, share splits and consolidations, DRP parcels with their own acquisition date, foreign withholding tax, and deductible interest on recorded debt recycling. What is not: broker-specific parcel selection, foreign-currency conversion at transaction-date rates (USD sales are shown separately and still need converting), enforcement of the 45-day franking rule, mergers, demergers and takeovers, and anything specific to trusts, SMSFs or businesses.

Your data stays with you
Everything is saved locally in your browser. Your holdings are never uploaded to a server or cloud account, and no account is required. Export to JSON any time to back up your data or move it to another device. Folder Sync can write straight to a file you choose, so if you point it at a folder your own cloud already syncs, your data reaches your other devices without ever passing through anything of ours. Note that browser storage is tied to where the file is opened from, so if you rename or move the file, load your JSON backup into it.

API dependency
Live prices are powered by CoinGecko and Yahoo Finance, with DexScreener used for wallet tokens that CoinGecko has not listed. TradingView market widgets are optional and off by default; turning them on loads a script from TradingView, which means they see your IP address and any symbol you look up, though never your holdings. News & Sentiment uses Google News RSS with a Yahoo Finance RSS fallback, fetched through a chain of free CORS proxies (or your own Marketaux, Finnhub, or Alpha Vantage key if you add one). If these services change, go down, or become unavailable, any feature that relies on them - price fetching, Investment Overview, Terminal data, News & Sentiment - will stop working. If that happens, a future update will look at replacing them with alternative free APIs. In the meantime, Folionaire still works fully as a transaction ledger, CGT calculator, and portfolio tracker using your last known prices or manual entries.

Running locally
For best results, serve this file from a local web server rather than opening it directly as a file in your browser. Opening via file:// can trigger CORS restrictions that block API calls. A simple local server (e.g. Python's http.server, Node's serve, or Termux on Android) resolves this. All data stays on your device regardless.

Updates & support
Your purchase includes free updates for the life of v1 (every v1.x release). Major versions (v2 onwards) are a separate A$10 upgrade for existing owners, and your current version never expires. Questions or feedback: folionaire@outlook.com.
